verdict.summary_en: Order acknowledgement OA25153955 from Boise Semiconductor Inc. to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318579 (2025-11-12). It confirms two lines of CMP-GAM-002 Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5 at 6.11 USD each: 8,000 pcs for 2025-12-12 and 9,500 pcs for 2025-12-17, 17,500 pcs in total. Terms are EXW Boise, payment NET30. The delivery-terms note contradicts itself.
red_flags: The terms contradict each other: EXW Boise is stated, but the note also says freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by Seller and added to the invoice. Under EXW the buyer normally bears these costs. The note also says DDP is not agreed. Clarify who arranges and pays freight, insurance and duties, and whether they will be invoiced.
The document has no printed document date (only the PO date 2025-11-12).
The confirmation splits delivery into two dates: 8,000 on 2025-12-12 and 9,500 on 2025-12-17. The original PO quantity and dates are not shown, so they cannot be compared here.
observations: The document is a clean printed PDF with no handwriting, stamps, signatures or strike-throughs.
No supplier part number is shown, only the buyer material number CMP-GAM-002.
The quantity column is headed only 'Qty'. It is recorded as quantity_confirmed because this is an order confirmation.
The description wraps across three lines in the table (Game Card 64 / GB – Grand / Heist 5).
